result:
All 617 tests pass and typecheck is clean. Summary of fixes made across the invitation/membership lifecycle:

- **`member-repository.ts`**: `insertMember` now always sets status `"active"` (previously stuck at `"invited"` forever, breaking `resolveActor` and undercounting seats). Added `findMemberIncludingArchived`, `reviveMember` (restores a former member's same id with the new role/inviter/join date), and `findActiveMemberByEmail`.
- **`invitation-repository.ts`**: Fixed `EXPIRY_UNIT_MS` from 1 hour to 1 day (invitations were expiring in 14 hours, not 14 days). `countPendingInvitations` and `listPendingInvitations` now exclude revoked and expired invitations, so they stop holding seats or cluttering the invitations page. Added `findInvitationById` (for resend, including expired ones) and `findPendingInvitationByEmail`.
- **`invitation-service.ts`**: `inviteMembers` now refuses a batch that repeats an email or targets an existing member/pending invitee (case-insensitive). `acceptInvitation` now checks the org isn't deleted, verifies the accepting account's email matches the invitation (case-insensitive), and revives a former member's row instead of failing on the unique constraint. `resendInvitation` now looks up the invitation directly (working for expired ones), preserves the original role instead of downgrading to `"member"`, and rejects already-accepted/revoked invitations.
- **`session-repository.ts`** / **`member-service.ts`** / **`organization-service.ts`**: Removing a member or deleting an org now clears just the affected sessions' `activeOrgId`, so the app stops defaulting to a workspace the user no longer has access to.
- **`notification-service.ts`** / **`digest-service.ts`**: Notifications and digests now skip recipients who are no longer members of the org.
